post.description: Events of a workspace over its ingest quota are counted in `limited` and dropped; the rest of the batch is unaffected. Signed like /internal/edge/resolve. Body `{events:[{id,at,ua,body}]}`; each `body` is validated as a public event. Replays of the same `id`/`at` are dropped. 503 INGEST_BACKPRESSURE tells the queue to retry later.
